deck: BROKER OTHER PEOPLE'S IRON ON CONSIGNMENT FOR 5 TO 12 PERCENT ACROSS RETAIL, WHOLESALE, AND AUCTION
READ PRICES THROUGH SUPPLY, HOUR METERS, HIDDEN OIL LEAKS, AND DOCUMENTED SERVICE HISTORY
site_ui.lead: Practitioners who broker, auction, inspect, finance, rent, haul, and machine used equipment show how a home-office broker earns 5 to 12 percent on someone else's machine by pricing on condition, reading auction supply, and demanding the paperwork buyers pay for.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies, with every claim carried by timestamped inline attribution to the source video. The chapters run from consignment brokering and auction price reading through inspection, liens and fraud, finance, rental economics, heavy haul, carrier compliance, CNC shops, medical imaging and data-center gear, and adjacent business models.
chapters: Buying and Selling at Equipment Auctions
Liens, Sales Paperwork, and Fraud Risks
Rental Economics and Contractor Equipment Costs
CNC Machines, Shop Economics, and Used Purchases
Adjacent Business Models and Equipment Case Studies
flow: Sign consignors averaging 3.5 machines each and hunt badly presented listings that open the door to tougher negotiation and lower prices.
Call the seller before money moves and get the story of why the machine is on the market: a fire, worn-out iron, or a job that ran out.
Count hour-meter digits on older Deere tractors, climb up to check transmission and hydraulic housings for oil, and look for fresh drip stripes where it parked.
Price on condition, not seller hope, using hour-banded auction comps and supply shifts, and bring work orders and warranty paperwork that buyers pay for.
Refuse to go live with poor photos or thin descriptions and push one listing to several channels, then play the long game of 105 days or more.
Shield the seller from tire kickers, probe price by phone, and close remotely, with the Academy selling over 50 percent of equipment sight unseen.

tagline: Big Money. Small Teams. No Bullshit.
title: EQUIPMENT BROKERAGE
subtitle: Consign the Iron, Price on Condition, Measure the Wear, Clear the Lien, and Broker the Money Behind the Seller
